# Spec lock
## Rules
- Canonical sidecar: persisted spec `spec-lock.json`, valid JSON. Lock-less specs valid; ordinary reads never create lock. Creation only archive, explicit initialization, create-worthy mutation; semantic no-op lock-less mutation creates none.
- `schema.name`/version required, immutable except guarded reassignment: validate target artifacts; preserve implementation/optimizations; preserve dependencies without target extraction, otherwise target extraction must equal current; same schema no-op.
- `dependsOn` canonical persisted IDs; authoritative metadata projection, including schemas without extraction.
- Implementation entry: workspace:path under workspace/codeRoot, normalized forward slashes; optional nonempty symbols = symbol-level, absent = file-level.
- Optional `optimizedDescription`/`optimizedContext`: each has value, captured schema, artifact-state filename→hash/lastModified; baseline independent, set/clear one preserves other, omit all-empty optimizations. Reassignment stales baseline without clearing/regenerating; never synthesize state from metadata.
- Initialization one-time: derive dependencies schema/artifacts, `implementation: []`, omit optimizations. Writers: archive, dependency/implementation/optimization/schema mutation, initialization, integrity maintenance; shared pure whole-document build + conditional revision write.
- Archive raw implementation path must belong spec workspace; exclude graph.excludePaths, discard unnormalizable, fail confirmed outside codeRoot.
- Sidecar source for implementation/optimizations; metadata projection cannot invent/change/delete either, only projects fresh optimized field. `SpecRepository.persistedStateMeta(spec, { includeHash: true })?.hash` is SHA-256 sidecar bytes; callers never read sidecar; `Spec.get().persistedStateStamp` exposes presence/lastModified.
## Constraints
- Non-reassignment writer never replaces schema.
- Preserve file- vs symbol-level links.
- Concurrent writers never silently overwrite.
